svg.title: A common scalar transport balance
svg.desc: The time derivative of density times a scalar, plus advective transport, equals gradient-diffusion transport plus a source term.

text.font-family: Cambria Math, Cambria, DejaVu Serif, serif

svg.text: ρ: density · u: velocity · φ: transported scalar · Γ: diffusion coefficient in this formulation
Sφ: source term · ∇: spatial differential operator
Assumes a gradient-diffusion flux; constitutive choices and source terms are problem-specific.
